attributes.name: ypy-upload-progress
attributes.description: Reports the progress of a file upload. A request whose multipart body holds a file that is not empty is sent with XMLHttpRequest and fires `ypy:upload:progress` on the element. The value is optional: a selector names an element that shows the percentage (a `<progress>` gets `value`; any element gets the CSS variable `--ypy-upload`). `false` turns it off.

values.name: false
values.description: Do not report progress; the request uses fetch.

events.name: ypy:upload:progress
events.description: Fires on the source element while a file is sent. `percent` is a whole number from 0 to 100; `total` is 0 when the browser does not know the size of the body.
